description: This file defines custom Cypress command extensions for functional testing of a web application related to OrangeHRM. It includes commands for login, API login, element retrieval, interacting with inputs and toasts, and managing form validation states.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs a login by visiting the login page and filling username and password fields, then submitting the form.

methods.name: loginTo
methods.description: Performs a login to a specified URL with given credentials, then submitting the form.

methods.name: apiLogin
methods.description: Performs an API-based login via a POST request with provided username and password.

methods.name: getOXD
methods.description: Retrieves specific OXD elements based on a type.

methods.name: getOXDInput
methods.description: Finds an input element associated with a specific label within the OXD elements.

methods.name: toast
methods.description: Checks for a toast message of a specific type with given message text.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of an input or textarea element and dispatches an input event.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Verifies if a form input or related element contains an invalid message.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects an option from a dropdown element.
